    StartersToothpick cheese cubesCheddar, salami and cherry tomato on toothpicks, laid out in neat rows of tenHow to make it200g cheddar100g salami250g cherry tomatoes20 toothpicksCut the cheddar into 20 even cubes.Thread each onto a toothpick with a fold of salami and a cherry tomato.Lay out in two neat rows of exactly ten.Vegas buffet prawnsPoached prawns served on ice with horseradish cocktail sauce and lemonHow to make it500g green prawns125ml tomato sauce1 tbsp horseradish2 lemons2 cups crushed icePoach the prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel.Mix the tomato sauce with horseradish and a squeeze of lemon.Pile the prawns on crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.Pecan cheddar cheese balls on toothpicksCheddar and cream cheese balls rolled in toasted pecans, each on a toothpickHow to make itNot on tonight's cookBite-size balls of sharp cheddar, cream cheese, spring onion and Worcestershire rolled in toasted pecans, each speared on a toothpick and lined up in rows.Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 200g finely grated vintage cheddar, 2 finely chopped spring onions, 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce and a pinch of cayenne.Chill 30 minutes until firm.Toast 100g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes and chop finely.Roll the mix into 24 small balls and coat in the pecans.Chill 1 hour, push a toothpick into each and line them up in neat rows.Fish finger sliders with tartareFish fingers, tartare. Boxer shorts must come from K-MartHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main MealPancakes, syrup firstButtermilk pancakes cooked in butter, stacked high, with maple syrupHow to make it1 bottle maple syrup300g plain flour2 tsp baking powder2 tbsp caster sugar500ml buttermilk2 eggs60g butterPut the maple syrup on the table before anything else.Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, buttermilk and eggs and rest.Cook in butter until bubbles set, then flip.Stack high.$86,000 Caesars Palace sirloin with loaded baked potatoThick seared sirloin with garlic butter, and a jacket spud with bacon and cheddarHow to make itNot on tonight's cookThick sirloin seared hard and finished with garlic butter, a jacket potato loaded with sour cream, bacon, cheddar and chives, and creamed spinach.Rub 4 potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200°C for 60 minutes.Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp.Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and stir into 150ml cream simmered with garlic and nutmeg.Season 4 sirloin steaks and sear in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, add 40g butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves and baste for 1 minute.Rest 5 minutes.Split the potatoes and load with sour cream, bacon, cheddar and chives.DessertFresh strawberry jelly with vanilla creamSet fresh strawberry jelly topped with vanilla cream and crumbled shortbreadHow to make it600g strawberries100g caster sugar1 lemon, juiced4 gelatine leaves200ml thickened cream1 tsp vanilla bean paste1 tbsp icing sugar2 shortbread fingersHull and blend most of the strawberries with the sugar and lemon juice, then strain.Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water, squeeze and dissolve in a portion of the warmed puree.Stir into the rest of the puree and pour into four glasses over sliced strawberries.Chill until set.Whip the cream with vanilla paste and icing sugar, spoon on and crumble over the shortbread.DrinksMaple syrup bourbon smashBourbon, mint and maple. The 1949 Buick Roadmaster stays on the drivewayHow to make it200ml bourbon60ml maple syrup3 lemons, juiced32 mint leaves1 green apple2 cups crushed iceJuice the lemons and slice the apple thinly.Press the mint gently with the syrup and lemon juice in a shaker, one drink at a time.Add bourbon and ice, shake hard, and strain into rocks glasses packed with crushed ice.Garnish with a mint sprig and an apple slice.Vegas gin martiniIce cold, one olive.
